hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT hw-rx-alloc diagnostic FIT
inputs.revision: RAM-loaded diagnostic kernel; FIT SHA256 identifies the tested package.

inputs.name: WPA2-PSK/CCMP/PMF0 profile and selected AP
inputs.revision: WPA2 trial against the configured AP; identifiers omitted.

scenario: On one operator-reported ESP-Mosaico V1.2 sample, run WPA2-PSK/CCMP/PMF0 using a RAM-loaded hw-rx-alloc diagnostic FIT, with bounded runtime-table, hardware-RX and internal-pool counters.
expected: Associate and complete WPA, while recording ingress, opaque hardware counters and internal-pool pressure.
observed: The station reached ASSOCIATED but did not complete WPA; it disconnected locally with reason 204 after a PTK four-way handshake timeout. The AP record shows station deauthentication after the timeout, but does not establish M1 transmission or acknowledgement. All four instrumented table-wrapper counters were zero; the live table pointer remained stable and all four instrumented slots matched wrappers (mask 0xf). This does not establish absence of ordinary STA ingress: wifi_create_sta registers sta_rx_cb for ifidx 0 at pTxRx+0x3f8, and sta_rx_cb tailcalls ROM sta_input directly, bypassing the instrumented net80211 table wrappers. That callback was not counted in this trial. The hardware getter returned rc=0 and opaque counters showed rx_mpdu=37640, rx_end_cnt=37879, rx_datasuc=139, buffer-full=92 and FIFO-overflow=0. Internal-pool misses, successful fallback, requested bytes and final NULL were zero in the measured connection window; free memory moved from 233552 to 233072 bytes and the window minimum was 197264 bytes. Several setup start/stop cycles preceded selection, outside that measured connection window.

measurements.name: disconnect-reason
measurements.unit: local disconnect after PTK four-way handshake timeout

measurements.name: instrumented-table-wrapper-entries
measurements.unit: calls across sta_input, crypto_decap, decap and sta_rx_eapol wrappers

measurements.name: registered-sta-rx-callback
measurements.unit: calls counted; callback at pTxRx+0x3f8 was not instrumented

limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and one RAM-loaded diagnostic run; the result does not establish support for other revisions or persistent Wi-Fi operation.

The four instrumented net80211 table-wrapper counters do not cover the registered normal STA callback at pTxRx+0x3f8, which directly tailcalls ROM sta_input. Their zero count is not evidence that normal STA ingress was absent. The next diagnostic should count that actual callback.
Internal-pool misses, fallback and NULL were zero in this measured connection window only. Several setup start/stop cycles happened before the window.

Espressif does not document the hardware counter increment conditions or frame types. These values show opaque hardware activity and cannot establish reception of DATA or EAPOL, nor distinguish filtering from memory pressure.
The AP record confirms association and station deauthentication after the PTK timeout, not AP transmission or station acknowledgement of M1.
No EAPOL input, WPA_COMPLETED, negotiated PMF, IP address, DNS or accepted network data exchange was observed. Wi-Fi support remains partial.
